dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: That smell... the fragrance of true Liyue cuisine.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Ahem... you must have put a lot of effort into finding these blueprints for Rain Calmer, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: Your liking for Liyue also signifies your approval of my work... Thank you.
